job.title: Sales associate
job.descriptionText: Pulsefit sells gym management software to small studios. The associate runs demos, follows up with leads, and keeps notes in the CRM.

studentTurns: Hi, thanks for taking my call. I'm Jordan from Pulsefit. We make software for gyms with class booking, member billing, a mobile app and reports. It has a lot of features and our customers like it.
It also integrates with payment processors, sends emails to members, and has a dashboard for staff. We have more than 200 studios using it, and the price starts at 79 dollars a month.
Does that sound like something your studio could use? Let me know if you want more information and I can send some details.
